1: // Minimal Stellar Drift game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Ship state
9: let ship = {
10:   x: canvas.width / 2,
11:   y: canvas.height / 2,
12:   angle: 0,
13:   vx: 0,
14:   vy: 0,
15:   radius: 10,
16:   thrusting: false,
17: };
18: // Audio setup
19: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
20: let lastThrustTime = 0;
21: function playTone(freq, dur) {
22:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
23:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
24:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
25:   osc.type = 'sine';
26:   osc.connect(gain);
27:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:   osc.start();
30:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
31: }
32: function playThrust() {
33:   const now = performance.now();
34:   if (now - lastThrustTime > 100) { // throttle to 10 per sec
35:     playTone(200, 0.08);
36:     lastThrustTime = now;
37:   }
38: }
39: function playCollect() { playTone(800, 0.12); }
40: function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 0.6); }
41: // Starfield background
42: const stars = [];
43: function initStars(count = 150) {
44:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
45:     stars.push({
46:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
47:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
48:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
49:     });
50:   }
51: }
52: initStars();
53: 
54: // Input handling
55: const keys = {};
56: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
57:   keys[e.code] = true;
58:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
59: });
60: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
61: 
62: // Entities
63: let asteroids = [];
64: let orbs = [];
65: let score = 0;
66: let gameOver = false;
67: 
68: function spawnAsteroid() {
69:   const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
70:   let x, y, vx, vy;
71:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
72:   switch (side) {
73:     case 0: // top
74:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
75:       y = -20;
76:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
77:       vy = speed;
78:       break;
79:     case 1: // bottom
80:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
81:       y = canvas.height + 20;
82:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
83:       vy = -speed;
84:       break;
85:     case 2: // left
86:       x = -20;
87:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
88:       vx = speed;
89:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
90:       break;
91:     case 3: // right
92:       x = canvas.width + 20;
93:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
94:       vx = -speed;
95:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
96:       break;
97:   }
98:   asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random() * 10 });
99: }
100: 
101: function spawnOrb() {
102:   const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
103:   let x, y, vx, vy;
104:   const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
105:   switch (side) {
106:     case 0:
107:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
108:       y = -10;
109:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
110:       vy = speed;
111:       break;
112:     case 1:
113:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
114:       y = canvas.height + 10;
115:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
116:       vy = -speed;
117:       break;
118:     case 2:
119:       x = -10;
120:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
121:       vx = speed;
122:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
123:       break;
124:     case 3:
125:       x = canvas.width + 10;
126:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
127:       vx = -speed;
128:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
129:       break;
130:   }
131:   orbs.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 5 });
132: }
133: 
134: // Simple collision test
135: function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) {
136:   return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by);
137: }
138: 
139: function update(dt) {
140:   // Update starfield (slow drift)
141:   stars.forEach(s => {
142:     s.x -= 0.2;
143:     if (s.x < 0) s.x = canvas.width;
144:     s.y += 0.1;
145:     if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;
146:   });
147:   if (gameOver) return;
148:   // Controls
149:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 0.12;
150:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 0.12;
151:   if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
152:     const thrust = 0.08;
153:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
154:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
155:     ship.thrusting = true;
156:     playThrust();
157:   } else {
158:     ship.thrusting = false;
159:   }
160:   // Apply drift (slow friction)
161:   ship.vx *= 0.99;
162:   ship.vy *= 0.99;
163:   ship.x += ship.vx;
164:   ship.y += ship.vy;
165: 
166:   // Keep drifting off-screen detection
167:   if (
168:     ship.x < -30 || ship.x > canvas.width + 30 ||
169:     ship.y < -30 || ship.y > canvas.height + 30
170:   ) {
171:     gameOver = true;
172:   }
173: 
174:   // Update asteroids
175:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
176:     a.x += a.vx;
177:     a.y += a.vy;
178:     // off‑screen removal
179:     if (a.x < -40 || a.x > canvas.width + 40 || a.y < -40 || a.y > canvas.height + 40) {
180:       a.remove = true;
181:     }
182:     // Collision with ship
183:     if (dist(a.x, a.y, ship.x, ship.y) < a.r + ship.radius) {
184:       playExplosion();
185:       gameOver = true;
186:     }
187:   });
188:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => !a.remove);
189: 
190:   // Update orbs
191:   orbs.forEach(o => {
192:     o.x += o.vx;
193:     o.y += o.vy;
194:     if (o.x < -20 || o.x > canvas.width + 20 || o.y < -20 || o.y > canvas.height + 20) {
195:       o.remove = true;
196:     }
197:     if (dist(o.x, o.y, ship.x, ship.y) < o.r + ship.radius) {
198:       score += 1;
199:       playCollect();
200:       o.remove = true;
201:     }
202:   });
203:   orbs = orbs.filter(o => !o.remove);
204: 
205:   // Random spawns
206:   if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
207:   if (Math.random() < 0.015) spawnOrb();
208: }
209: 
210: function draw() {
211:   // Space gradient background
212:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
213:   grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
214:   grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
215:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
216:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
217: 
218:   // Starfield (twinkling)
219:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
220:   stars.forEach(s => {
221:     ctx.beginPath();
222:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
223:     ctx.fill();
224:   });
225: 
226:   // Ship with thrust flame
227:   ctx.save();
228:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
229:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
230:   // Ship body
231:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
232:   ctx.beginPath();
233:   ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
234:   ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
235:   ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
236:   ctx.closePath();
237:   ctx.fill();
238:   // Thrust flame
239:   if (ship.thrusting) {
240:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
241:     ctx.beginPath();
242:     ctx.moveTo(-8, -4);
243:     ctx.lineTo(-14, 0);
244:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 4);
245:     ctx.closePath();
246:     ctx.fill();
247:   }
248:   ctx.restore();
249: 
250:   // Asteroids with simple shading
251:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
252:     const gradA = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
253:     gradA.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
254:     gradA.addColorStop(1, '#555');
255:     ctx.fillStyle = gradA;
256:     ctx.beginPath();
257:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
258:     ctx.fill();
259:   });
260: 
261:   // Orbs with glow effect
262:   orbs.forEach(o => {
263:     const orbGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r * 2);
264:     orbGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
265:     orbGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,165,0,0)');
266:     ctx.fillStyle = orbGrad;
267:     ctx.beginPath();
268:     ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
269:     ctx.fill();
270:   });
271: 
272:   // UI overlay
273:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
274:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
275:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
276:   if (gameOver) {
277:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
278:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
279:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
280:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
281:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
282:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
283:   }
284: }
285: 
286: let last = performance.now();
287: function loop(now) {
288:   const dt = now - last;
289:   last = now;
290:   update(dt);
291:   draw();
292:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
293: }
294: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
295: 
296: // Export for debugging (optional)
297: export { ship, asteroids, orbs, score, gameOver };

(End of file - total 297 lines)
